candidates.name: Warthin tumor
support_spans: painless, non-erythematous, mobile, round mass (~2 cm) in the right parotid region
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of a painless, mobile mass in the parotid region is consistent with Warthin tumor.

candidates.name: Pleomorphic adenoma
support_spans: lobulated, well-circumscribed, hypoechogenic cystic lesion with irregular edges and acoustic enhancement in the superficial parenchyma of the right parotid gland
candidates.why: The ultrasonography findings of a lobulated, well-circumscribed lesion are consistent with Pleomorphic adenoma.

candidates.name: Salivary duct carcinoma
support_spans: cystic background with “dirty” necrosis and pseudopapillary clusters of moderately atypical cells with cyanophilic cytoplasm
candidates.why: The cytological findings are suspicious for malignancy, which is consistent with Salivary duct carcinoma.

candidates.name: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma
support_spans: cystic lesion with irregular edges and acoustic enhancement in the superficial parenchyma of the right parotid gland
candidates.why: The ultrasonography findings of a cystic lesion with irregular edges are consistent with Mucoepidermoid carcinoma.

candidates.name: Pleomorphic adenoma
support_spans: Contrast-enhanced CT of the face and thorax demonstrated a homogeneously enhancing nodular lesion
candidates.why: The CT findings of a homogeneously enhancing nodular lesion can help confirm the diagnosis of Pleomorphic adenoma.

key_evidence_spans: A 63-year-old Caucasian man with a history of smoking and cardiovascular disease presented with a 1-month history of right cheek swelling
painless, non-erythematous, mobile, round mass (~2 cm) in the right parotid region
ultrasonography showed a single lobulated, well-circumscribed, hypoechogenic cystic lesion with irregular edges and acoustic enhancement in the superficial parenchyma of the right parotid gland
cystic background with “dirty” necrosis and pseudopapillary clusters of moderately atypical cells with cyanophilic cytoplasm
Contrast-enhanced CT of the face and thorax demonstrated a homogeneously enhancing nodular lesion in the superficial lobe of the right parotid gland
The specimen was classified as category V (suspicious for malignancy) by the Milan System
salivary duct carcinoma was initially considered
